distinguishing_fact: Model 225B is composed of uncoated brass and is not coated or plated with precious metal.
reasoning: Model 225B is composed of brass (61% copper, 35% zinc, 4% other material). In accordance with Note 5 to Section XV, alloys of base metals are classified as the metal that predominates by weight, which is copper. Pursuant to Note 1(b) to Chapter 74, it constitutes a copper alloy. Snap hooks with spring safety snaps and swiveling eyes are excluded from heading 8308 and classified in the appropriate base metal 'other articles' heading (heading 7419). Under heading 7419, following the nomenclature updates replacing 7419.99, the goods fall under subheading 7419.80. Within 7419.80, the snap hook is not wire cloth, a container, a spring, or a chain, and is not coated or plated with precious metal, leading to 8-digit subheading 7419.80.50.

citations.quote: an alloy of base metals of this section is to be classified as an alloy of the metal which predominates by weight over each of the other metals.
Metallic substances other than unrefined copper in which copper predominates by weight over each of the other elements
